dialogues.speaker: Aryadeva
dialogues.text: Hello, I'm planning to set up a Light Novel Society. Are you interested?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: A Light Novel Society?

dialogues.speaker: Aryadeva
dialogues.text: There are many societies in the Akademiya, but no Light Novel Society. It's strange, isn't it?

dialogues.speaker: Aryadeva
dialogues.text: Light novels don't seem popular in Sumeru, but it is the Nation of Wisdom after all. There shouldn't be any gaps in our fields of knowledge.

dialogues.speaker: Aryadeva
dialogues.text: I am not exactly a researcher of the Akademiya, but I am second to none when it comes to light novels.

dialogues.speaker: Aryadeva
dialogues.text: Should we have an initiation ceremony or something like that?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Who are you...

dialogues.speaker: Aryadeva
dialogues.text: I haven't studied in the Akademiya, but I'd like to consider myself a Herbad in the field of light novels.

dialogues.speaker: Aryadeva
dialogues.text: However, there is no school in the Akademiya that awards diplomas in light novels.

dialogues.speaker: Aryadeva
dialogues.text: That's why it's pertinent to have my book published by Yae Publishing House. My book's title is "Can a Trainee Combat Mage Whose Normal Attack Summons a Jinni that Will Start a Full-Out Free-For-All Really Graduate From the Magic Akademiya?"

dialogues.speaker: Aryadeva
dialogues.text: I didn't expect my manuscript to be rejected again. Those Yae Publishing House editors are really strict...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Please excuse me now...

dialogues.speaker: Aryadeva
dialogues.text: If you want to join the society, just let me know.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About the Kory Drums...

dialogues.speaker: Aryadeva
dialogues.text: How did you hear about the Kory Drums? Did the Adventurers' Guild tell you?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: We're adventurers that specialize in solving particular problems.

dialogues.speaker: Aryadeva
dialogues.text: Oh, well that's good to hear. If that's the case, there's a burden off my chest.

dialogues.speaker: Aryadeva
dialogues.text: You should have already seen that fool child Nasejuna, yes? The fact that you're standing here means that his plot failed.

dialogues.speaker: Aryadeva
dialogues.text: Before, when Nasejuna asked me about the Kory Drums, I knew he was up to no good.

dialogues.speaker: Aryadeva
dialogues.text: Hence, I deliberately hid the fact that I had one of the Kory Drums and entrusted it to an acquaintance I have in the Akademiya...

dialogues.speaker: Aryadeva
dialogues.text: The glory days of the Order of Skeptics are bygone legends by now. Rather than harboring their dangerous delusions, its better to see their desires manifest in light novels instead.
